title: Designing next-generation all-weather and efficient atmospheric water harvesting powered by solar energy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01454A, Perspective
Pengfei Wang, Jiaxing Xu, Zhaoyuan Bai, Ruzhu Wang, Tingxian Li
We propose a next-generation solar-powered hybrid atmospheric water harvesting system for all-weather and efficient water production worldwide, which leverages the advantages of complementary AWH mechanisms with synergistic integration of heat pump.
